questions.question: If (2x + y)³ - (x - 2y)³ = (x + 3y)[Ax² + By² + Cxy], then what is the value of (A + 2B + C)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(2x + y)3 - (x - 2y)3 = (x + 3y)[Ax2 + By2 + Cxy]

**Concept used:**

x³ - y³ = (x - y)(x² + y² + xy)

**Calculation:**

(2x + y)3 - (x - 2y)3 = (2x + y - x + 2y)[(2x + y)² + (x - 2y)² + (2x + y)(x - 2y)]

⇒ (x + 3y)[4x² + y² + 4xy + x² + 4y² - 4xy + 2x² - 4xy + xy - 2y²]

⇒ (x + 3y)[7x2 + 3y2 - 3xy]

So,

A = 7

B = 3

C = - 3

Now,

(A + 2B + C) = 7 + 6 - 3 = 10

**∴ Required answer is 10**

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which ∠A = x°, ∠B = 5y°, ∠C = 2x° and ∠D = y°. What is the value of (3x - y)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠A = x°, ∠B = 5y°, ∠C = 2x°, and ∠D = y°

**Concept used:**

The sum of a pair of opposite angles is 180° (supplementary)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0067357877804bfa8c2c806cd38ac86b0c06795ad0b8adba8cd0f8dacd1a35eb.png] 

∠A + ∠C = 180° 

x + 2x = 180°

⇒ 3x = 180° 

⇒ x = 60° 

∠B + ∠D = 180°

5y + y = 180°

⇒ 6y = 180°

⇒ y = 30° 

(3x - y) = (60 × 3 - 30)

⇒ 180 - 30 = 150°

**∴ The value of (3x - y) is 150**

questions.question: A dealer bought some toys for Rs. 1800. He sold 40% of these at a loss of 15% and 33(1)/(3)\% of the remaining toys at 20% profit. At what percent profit should he sell the remaining toys to earn an overall profit of 10%.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP = Rs. 1800

**Concept used:**

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Profit = 1800 × 1/10 = Rs. 180

SP of 40% = 1800 × 2/5 × 17/20

⇒ Rs. 612

SP of 33.33% of the remaining = 1800 × 3/5 × 1/3 × 6/5

⇒ Rs. 432

Remaining portion = 1800 × 3/5 × 2/3 = 720

SP of remaining = 1980 - 612 - 432 = 936

Profit % = [(936 - 720)/720] × 100

⇒ 30%

**∴ Required profit percentage is 30%**

questions.question: Triangles ABC and DBC are right-angled triangles with common hypotenuse BC. BD and AC intersect at P when produced. If PA = 8 cm, PC = 4 cm and PD = 3.2 cm, then the length of BD, in cm, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

PA = 8 cm

PC = 4 cm

PD = 3.2 cm

**Formula used:**

PA × PC = PB × PD

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74bee3193875749c8f7adade75363dcaca89fbb19b4a99d654f7b50506feed25.png] 

ΔABP and ΔDCP are similar.

PA/PD = PB/PC

⇒ PA × PC = PB × PD 

⇒ 8 × 4 = 3.2 × PB

⇒ 32 = 3.2 × PB

⇒ 32/3.2 = PB

⇒ PB = 10

So,

BD = PB - PD

⇒ 10 - 3.2 = 6.8

**∴ The length of BD is 6.8 cm**

questions.question: There are some children in a camp and their average weight is 40 kg. If 5 children with average weight 36 kg join the camp or if 5 children with average weight 43.2 kg leave the camp, the average weight of children in both cases is equal. How many children are there in the camp, initially?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

There are some children in a camp and their average weight is 40 kg

Average of 5 children = 36 kg

Average of other 5 children = 43.2

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No of elements

**Calculation:**

Let total number of children in the camp be x

Average weight of x children = 40

Sum of weight of x children = 40x

Average weight of 5 children = 36 

Sum of weight of first 5 children = 36 × 5 = 180 

Average weight of second 5 children = 43.2 

Sum of weight of 5 children = 43.2 × 5 = 216 

According to the question,

(40x + 180)/(x + 5) = (40x - 216)/(x - 5)

⇒ (40x + 180)(x - 5) = (40x - 216)(x + 5)

⇒ 40x² - 200x + 180x - 900 = 40x2 + 200x - 216x - 1080

⇒ 4x = 180

⇒ x = 45

**∴ initially 45 children were in the camp.**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 2, x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz = 74, then (x² + y² + z²) is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 2

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = 74

**Formula used:**

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c)/2 [3(a2 + b2 + c2) - (a + b + c)2]

**Calculation:**

According to the formula

2/2 [3(x² + y² + z²) - 2²] = 74

⇒ 3(x2 + y2 + z2) = 74 + 4

⇒ x2 + y2 + z2 = 78/3 = 26

**∴ Required answer is 26**

questions.question: A person borrowed a sum of Rs. 30800 at 10% p.a. for 3 years, interest compounded annually. At the end of two years, he paid a sum of Rs. 13268. At the end of 3rd year, he paid Rs. x to clear of the debt. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 30800

Rate = 10%

Time = 3 years

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

A= Amount

P = principal

r = rate of interest

t = time

**Calculation:**

After 2 years amount will be = 30800 × 11/10 × 11/10

⇒ Rs. 37268

He paid Rs. 13268

So, sum now = 37268 - 13268 = 24000

Amount after one year = 24000 × 11/10

⇒ Rs. 26400

**∴ The value of x is Rs. 26400**

questions.question: If the 9-digit number 89x64287y is divisible by 72, then what is the value of (3x + 2y)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

89x64287y

**Concept used:**

**Divisibility rule of 9:**

If the sum of digits of the number is divisible by 9, then the number itself is divisible by 9

**Divisibility rule of 8:**

If the last three digits of a number are divisible by 8, then the number is completely divisible by 8.

**Calculation:**

89x64287y

87y is divisible by 8

So, y = 2

Now,

8 + 9 + x + 6 + 4 + 2 + 8 + 7 + 2 = 46 + x

x = 8

So, 3x + 2y = 3 × 8 + 2 × 2 = 24 + 4 = 28

**∴ The value of (3x + 2y) is 28**

questions.question: A train running at 48 km/h crosses a man going with the speed of 12 km/h, in the same direction in 18 seconds and passes a woman coming from the opposite direction in 12 seconds. The speed (in km/h) of the woman is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 48 km/h

Speed of the man = 12 km/h

**Concept used:**

km/h × 5/18 = m/sec

Concept of relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed for 1st case = 48 - 12 = 36 km/h

Speed m/sec = 36 × 5/18 = 10 m/sec

So, length of the train = 18 × 10 = 180 m

Now,

In 2nd case

Speed = 180/12 = 15 m/sec

Speed in km = 15 × 18/5 = 54 km/h

Speed of the woman = 54 - 48 = 6 km

**∴ The speed of the woman is 6 km/h**
